[USER] User inquired about physical and mental challenges faced when beginning a yoga practice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Physical discomfort: As a beginner, you may face discomfort or even pain as your body adjusts to the poses.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Limited flexibility and mobility: A lack of flexibility and mobility may make some poses difficult to perform, which can be frustrating at first.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Poor balance: Many yoga poses require good balance, which can be challenging for those who struggle with it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Breathing difficulties: Breathing is an important part of yoga, and some people may initially find it hard to breathe properly during practice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mental distractions: It can be difficult to quiet the mind and focus on the present moment during a yoga class, especially if you are new to the practice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Overcoming self-judgment: Many people struggle with comparing themselves to others in a yoga class and judging their own abilities, but this can be overcome with practice and patience.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Building strength: Yoga requires a certain level of strength, and beginners may find it hard to hold certain poses for an extended period of time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Learning unfamiliar terminology: For someone who is new to yoga, terminology such as "downward dog," "child's pose," and "tree pose" may be unfamiliar and take time to learn.  
[USER] User asked if it is normal to feel sore after starting a yoga practice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It is quite common to feel sore after starting a yoga practice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] When beginning yoga, you are using muscles in new ways, and it may take some time for your body to adjust.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It's important to listen to your body and not push yourself too hard, especially when starting out.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Over time, your muscles will begin to adapt to the practice, and the soreness should diminish.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] It's also important to stay hydrated and to stretch after your practice to help alleviate any soreness.  
[USER] User expressed surprise at the challenges of yoga and asked how to avoid injury while starting a yoga practice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Listen to your body: Pay close attention to how your body feels during your practice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] If a pose feels uncomfortable or painful, back off or come out of the pose.
